backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.hint: Exports an encrypted snapshot of the whole vault, protected by the master password. The file name carries no sensitive data. Restore overwrites the current vault and keeps the old file as a backup.
backup.dataDirHint: Manual backup: lock or quit first, then copy the vault file to a USB drive; unlock with the same master password on another machine.
backup.pickHint: The button below opens the system file dialog to choose a save location or a backup file.
backup.importConfirm: Restore will overwrite the current vault; the existing file is kept as a backup. Continue?
backup.imported: Restored {entries} entries and {categories} categories. Unlock again with the backup's master password.
backup.webdavDisabled: Disabled (interface reserved; this version makes no network requests)

settings.autoLockHint: Locks the vault after the chosen period without mouse or keyboard input
settings.clipboardHint: Clears the copied password after the chosen delay; skipped if you copied something else in the meantime

toast.copyFailed: Copy failed, please select the text manually
